scope: Fresh different-author, source-only, no-remote/no-GPU/no-checkpoint/no-valid825/no-range/no-EDA/no-production hammer of M1177 E1/E8 closure

blocking_findings.finding: validate_launch accepts any repository file as m1175_result_hammer when the launch contract self-declares its SHA; it neither pins the exact M1175 review path/SHA nor parses PASS/admitted ep29 semantics.
blocking_findings.demonstrated_attack: A fixture receipt with status NOT_M1175_ADMISSION was accepted.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Pin exact M1175 review path and SHA 8b83690b...; strict-parse it and require PASS, ep29 SHA/size/mtime/config, samples825, zero load audit and E0 admitted.

blocking_findings.finding: Profiler and evaluator dependencies are self-certified by the successor contract against current bytes, not pinned to the M1177 source-contract hashes.
blocking_findings.demonstrated_attack: Two unrelated fixture Python files were accepted as profile/evaluator.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Pin and compare exact profile SHA 04f692c5... and evaluator SHA ba40b42c... in producer code, before and after import/child execution as applicable.

blocking_findings.finding: The declared canonical GPU lease constant is not enforced; a launch contract may choose any repository-relative lock and bypass the shared owner.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require gpu_ownership.lease_path equals hw_autoresearch_nts07/results/gpu_profile_lease.lock and reject all alternatives.

blocking_findings.finding: E1/E8 mode-specific input schemas are not exact. E8-only cohort material is accepted in E1, and extra keys are silently accepted.
blocking_findings.demonstrated_attack: An E1 contract containing an arbitrary E8 cohort passed validate_launch.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use exact key sets for common, E1-only and E8-only contracts; reject mode mixing, unknown keys and duplicate semantic authorities.

blocking_findings.finding: The 40-sample E8 cohort is launcher-selected: only length and IDs 0..39 are checked. No canonical cohort manifest/path/size/SHA population is pinned, so sample search or substitution can be sealed.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Bind a sealed canonical 40-source manifest (prefer the admitted unified-capture cohort), verify its own SHA/outer seal, then require exact row population/order/path/size/SHA with no extras.

blocking_findings.finding: All-layer closure is not fail-closed. The source requires only nonempty static, BN and dynamic populations; it has no exact layer census, unique-name/type/shape census, or every-layer-by-every-sample dynamic coverage check.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Derive and seal an exact model census after strict load; require every Conv/ConvTranspose/Linear export exactly once, every BN exactly once, and every declared dynamic layer exactly once per each of 40 samples. Reject omissions and duplicates.

blocking_findings.finding: BN export does not require gamma, beta, running_mean and running_var as an exact four-tensor set; missing tensors are silently omitted.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Require the exact four tensors, finite values, expected channel length and positive finite epsilon before sealing.

blocking_findings.finding: The M1177 source-hammer receipt is also only self-declared path+SHA; its schema/status/source SHA/outer seal are not parsed by the producer.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Successor release must pin the eventual M1179+ hammer path/SHA/outer seal, and producer must strict-parse PASS plus exact M1177 source/contract/test SHAs.

required_next_gate: Author a new immutable M1177 successor revision closing B1-B8; then run a fresh different-author source hammer. Do not overwrite or release the failed r1 source package.
